behaviour_contract: Light follows a four-update target history, with signed unit acceleration and ordinary speed clamp +/-8. It tracks the active fist or Rayman sprite2; the source uses sprite origin plus (size>1), not half-size. Death switches to angular drift and shrinking radius. Actual screen x is y_luc=x_main_luc-xmap+8, screen y is x_luc=y_main_luc-ymap. Keep radius growth/oscillation near54, clear fringe max movement+6, render radius-4, clipping save/install/restore and320-byte pitch. Shared coordinate names are deferred for coordinated renaming.
